name: ecommerce-app
description: E-commerce monorepo with backend API, storefront, and admin panel

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../admin-frontend && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin-frontend && npm install
